# Generated by tools/generate-firms.mjs - do not edit by hand.
# Firm variants and stages: one district slot each (rural ones also one district of
# their type). Placed only by script. Under the Guided and Mixed economy the player can
# clear them like blockers (influence; under Mixed also trade as compensation). Energy
# upkeep like the matching district, scaled by stage; housing like the district.

d_pe_firm_aaac = {
	icon = d_city
	is_for_colonizable = yes
	category = pe_deposit_cat_firms
	potential = { always = no }
	drop_weight = { weight = 0 }
	time = 180
	can_be_cleared_potential = { exists = owner owner = { OR = { has_policy_flag = pe_order_guided has_policy_flag = pe_order_mixed } } }
	can_be_cleared = { exists = owner owner = { OR = { has_policy_flag = pe_order_guided has_policy_flag = pe_order_mixed } } }
	ai_weight = { weight = 0 }
	on_cleared = { pe_firm_cleared = { COMP = 500 } }

	resources = {
		category = planet_deposits
		upkeep = {
			energy = 2
		}
		cost = {
			trigger = { planet = { owner = { has_policy_flag = pe_order_guided } } }
			influence = 30
		}
		cost = {
			trigger = { planet = { owner = { has_policy_flag = pe_order_mixed } } }
			influence = 50
			trade = 500
		}
	}

	planet_modifier = {
		planet_max_districts_add = -1
		planet_housing_add = 600
		job_pe_private_metallurgist_add = 150
		job_pe_private_artisan_add = 50
	}

	triggered_planet_modifier = {
		potential = { exists = owner owner = { has_valid_civic = civic_agrarian_idyll } }
		planet_housing_add = -200
	}

	triggered_planet_modifier = {
		potential = { exists = owner owner = { has_active_tradition = tr_prosperity_public_works } }
		planet_housing_add = 100
	}

	triggered_planet_modifier = {
		potential = { exists = owner owner = { has_technology = tech_housing_1 } }
		planet_housing_add = 100
	}

	triggered_planet_modifier = {
		potential = { exists = owner owner = { has_technology = tech_housing_2 NOT = { has_valid_civic = civic_agrarian_idyll } } }
		planet_housing_add = 200
	}
}
